title: Reconstruction Payment Desk Worksheet: Amount That Brings a Past-Due Draw Current
content:
The payment that brings a past-due draw current on a Reconstruction contract is figured on the contract's most recently requested customer-funded draw, the customer-funded draw with the highest draw number.

**Amount.** The payment toward a past-due draw is the draw's unpaid amount, its requested amount less every payment posted toward it, rounded to the cent, half up.

**Order of assembly.** The payment is put together in this order: first the draw's unpaid amount; then every amount the payment also carries is added; then every amount applied, retained or set aside against it is subtracted; a result below zero counts as zero; and only that result is rounded to the cent, half up.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Requested amount of the draw | $9,600.00 |
| Payments already posted toward it | $2,250.00 and $1,000.00 |
| Unpaid amount | $6,350.00 |
| Payment | $6,350.00 |

A draw requested at $4,180.25 with nothing yet paid toward it gives a payment of $4,180.25.
